summary: Standard BioTools filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, announcing the termination of its July 28, 2026 Share and Asset Purchase Agreement with Multiplex Bio Inc. to sell its mass cytometry business. Following a Business Superior Proposal from GMT Venture Partners, the company entered a new Share and Asset Purchase Agreement with Element Biosystems, LLC, a GMT Venture subsidiary, for $5.5 million cash on a cash-free, debt-free basis, subject to customary adjustments. A $1.5 million termination fee is payable to Multiplex Bio, partly offset by a $1.0 million payment from GMT Venture. GMT Venture provided an equity commitment letter, and the deal is not subject to a financing condition. The risk-arb angle is the closing mechanics and potential adjustment disputes.
